title: Game Rules
content:
# Happy Farmer

## Game Overview

You are a farmer working hard to run a farm in the countryside. Every day you plant, water, and harvest, and unlock more crops, facilities, and trading features as you progress.

The core goal of this game is simple: turn a patch of wasteland into a highly productive, high-value farm, and keep gaining stronger returns and richer systems as you level up.

---

## 1. Basic Flow

1. First buy land to expand your farmland.
2. Till the soil, sow seeds, and water to let crops grow smoothly.
3. Harvest mature crops to obtain materials and resources.
4. Sell agricultural products to merchants, the consignment market, or the factory to increase profits.
5. Level up the farm to unlock more crops, items, and features.

> As long as you keep managing it, the farm will grow bigger and your returns will grow higher.

---

## 2. Farmland Management

### 2.1 Land Operations

- Click a plot to till, plant, water, or harvest.
- A plot's state affects your next action.
- If a plot already has a crop, you must harvest or clear it before using it again.

### 2.2 Crop Growth

- Each crop has its own growth time.
- Watering helps crops grow more steadily.
- Crops can be harvested once mature, and harvesting converts them into inventory or gold income.

### 2.3 Storage and Seeds

- You need to manage your storage capacity well and avoid filling it up.
- Seeds are an important resource for farm management; before planting, confirm you have enough.
- Maintaining a good planting rhythm maximizes your returns.

---

## 3. Factory System

The factory is one of the most important sources of income after the farm is upgraded. You can process raw materials into higher-value finished products.

### 3.1 Production Flow

- Choose the product to process.
- First check whether the required materials are complete.
- If materials are insufficient, the system will show "Missing materials" or "Partial materials".
- When materials and gold are sufficient, you can start processing.

### 3.2 Completion and Collection

- After processing is complete, the finished product enters the "Completed, ready to collect" list.
- You can collect the finished products promptly to avoid pile-up.
- Collecting finished products requires checking whether storage still has space.

> The factory's value is often higher than selling raw materials directly, so it is a very critical economic source in the mid-to-late game.

---

## 4. Shop, Consignment and Market

### 4.1 Shop

- The shop is mainly used to buy seeds and basic resources.
- Arranging planting and purchasing reasonably improves efficiency.

### 4.2 Merchants

- Merchants visit from time to time.
- They buy specific types of crops and items.
- If the page is not in the foreground, the system will try to send a browser notification to remind you when a merchant arrives.

### 4.3 Consignment and Auction

- The consignment and auction mechanics let you trade larger market fluctuations for higher profits.
- Prices of different goods perform differently at different times.
- It is recommended to consign or auction when you have higher-value goods.

---

## 5. Next Day Update and Cooldown

- Each click of "Next Day" advances a new agricultural calendar.
- Each next day requires waiting for a certain cooldown.
- Currently set to a 60-second cooldown, suitable for keeping the rhythm without being too long.

### 5.1 Reminder When the Page Is Hidden

- If you are operating within the webpage, in-game prompts are enough and no extra browser popup is needed.
- But if you switch to another page, program, or tab, the system will send a desktop notification when needed, reminding you to return and continue managing.
- If the browser has not authorized notification permission, you will not be disturbed.

---

## 6. Tasks and Achievements

### 6.1 Daily Tasks

- Each day a new set of task goals is generated.
- Completing tasks grants gold rewards.
- When a task is completed, an in-game prompt pops up and a notification is sent when the page is hidden.

### 6.2 Achievement System

- There are many achievements in the game, covering farmland, economy, trading, and management.
- Achievements not only reflect your progress but also help you discover direction in gameplay.
- 

---

## 7. Management Tips

1. In the early game, ensure basic planting income first; do not expand blindly.
2. Stabilize planting first, then consider large-scale processing and market trading.
3. Watch merchant visits and factory returns carefully to avoid inefficient operations.
4. Handle storage and materials promptly to reduce resource waste.
5. Always pay attention to the next-day cooldown and notification reminders to avoid missing important events.

---

## 8. Summary

This is a farm game that emphasizes management rhythm and long-term accumulation. It does not rely on a single burst, but on the accumulation of daily details: tilling, planting, watering, harvesting, processing, and trading, ultimately building your own prosperous farm.

As long as you keep managing and make good use of merchants and the factory, you can grow your farm from a small operation into the farm empire you have always dreamed of.

---

## 9. Notes

- Game progress is saved locally in the browser.
- If you close the browser and return later, the previous state will be retained as much as possible.
- If you do not want to receive browser notifications, you can turn them off in settings.
- If you want a smoother experience, it is recommended to keep the page in the foreground to avoid interruptions.
- The game may not function properly if the page is minimized or the browser is closed.---

## 10. Game Operations

Quick-reference list of every operation in the game.

### 10.1 Farm Actions

- **Click empty plot (untilled)** → Confirm dialog opens; pay gold to till.
- **Click tilled empty plot** → Open "Pick a crop" panel and plant.
- **Click growing plot** → Shows progress; if mature, harvest directly.
- **Till All (🪓)** → Till every empty plot at once.
- **Water All (💧)** → Water all plots that need water (20 gold per plot).
- **Harvest All (🧺)** → Harvest every mature crop.
- **Buy Land (🔲)** → Pay gold to unlock a new plot.

### 10.2 Processing & Trading

- **Factory (🏭)** → Pick a product → Add ingredients → Start processing. Click "Collect" when done.
- **Consignment (📦)** → Pick an inventory item → Set terms → List it. Sold items settle automatically.
- **Auction (🔨)** → Once every 14 days you can start an auction; NPCs bid by market price.
- **Mall (🛒)** → Buy boosters (auto-water, double XP, etc.).

### 10.3 Currencies

- The gold display in the top bar is **clickable**. Click to open a detailed view of all 5 currency tiers (Copper / Copper Coin / Silver / Gold Coin / Diamond).
- In that dialog you can **Upgrade** (110 lower → 1 higher) or **Downgrade** (1 higher → 100 lower).
- Every exchange has a 10% loss — be careful.
- Tap the ❔ icon for the currency system explanation.

### 10.4 Settings & Saves

- **Settings (⚙️)** → Language, audio, layout, browser notifications, auto-save, etc.
- **Save (💾)** → Immediately write the current progress to localStorage.
- **Export Save** → Package your progress into a `.lelelefarmer` file.
- **Import Save** → Restore progress from a `.lelelefarmer` file.

### 10.5 Mouse / Touch Hints

- **Right-click on any button** (or long-press on mobile) → Show what that button does.
- **Hover the gold display** → Shows "Click to view all currencies".

### 10.6 Common Shortcuts

- **Next Day (⏩)** → Advance the game (subject to cooldown).
- **Sidebar** → On mobile, tap the bottom toolbar to switch between Seed Shop / Inventory / Factory / Settings.
